environment.postgresForPassedDbSmoke: isolated Windows-native PostgreSQL 18 cluster, loopback-only random port, synthetic data

stages.expected: Complete persistence ownership, tenant/transaction/lock semantics, default skip register, and deployment decisions.
stages.actual: Static inventory scans 430 production TS files; 207 persistence candidates have feature/process owners, but all 207 still require semantic review. Skip patterns and decision register are generated; deployment values and historical baseline artifacts remain unknown.

stages.expected: Repeatable isolated PostgreSQL and Redis suites, with unsupported modes explicit.
stages.actual: Windows-native isolated PostgreSQL harness is implemented and DB-only modules passed. Docker Engine is unavailable; Redis and Docker Compose modes remain unverified.

stages.expected: Reports repositories and tenant-scoped projections behave against a real database.
stages.actual: Isolated PostgreSQL smoke passed reports, contacts, dashboard, lead allocation/idempotency, registry pacing, deletion history, and unauthenticated HTTP boundary. A real history query defect was fixed and re-tested.

stages.expected: Extract and verify transactional Grouping and Review writes, concurrency and audit rollback.
stages.actual: Review decision persistence now sits behind ReviewRepository; tenant/grant scope, correction/conflict decisions and audit rollback pass on isolated PostgreSQL. Grouping resolver still performs persistence directly, and the full grouping concurrency matrix is incomplete.

stages.expected: Separate lead reads, allocation, contact, results and export persistence while preserving CAS/idempotency.
stages.actual: Lead allocation and idempotency behavior passed within reports smoke; service persistence extraction and the broader specified regression matrix remain incomplete.

stages.expected: Extract admission/dispatch/outbox persistence and validate PostgreSQL–Redis failure windows.
stages.actual: Submission/outbox-related tenant-scope smoke passed. Dedicated Redis, multi-publisher, restart and dispatch failure-window tests were not run; Docker Engine is unavailable.

stages.expected: Verify file finalization failure recovery and privileged action replay/rollback on PostgreSQL.
stages.actual: Privileged actions and deletion DB smokes passed for relevant behavior; export finalization extraction and injected file-publication/commit failure tests remain incomplete.

stages.expected: Remove global DB facade and all temporary architecture exceptions.
stages.actual: Architecture, transaction audit and HTTP contract checks pass. Review removal reduced layer exceptions from 20 to 17; 17 layer, 90 public-export and 19 source-direction exceptions remain, and the global facade is still present.

stages.expected: Complete HTTP, DB and UI module matrix and resolve every required skip on fixture.
stages.actual: All 59 manifest skip patterns were assigned to dedicated fixture suites, which passed (security smoke; Everest 27/27; Compensa 39/39; UFG 14/14). The default full run still reports 70 skipped worker cases; route-by-route HTTP/UI coverage remains outstanding.

stages.expected: Validate isolated production Compose stack and deployment configuration.
stages.actual: Production Compose configuration passed synthetic-fixture resolution and policy checks. Docker Engine is unavailable, so images/services were not started.

stages.expected: Test backup, cold restore, integrity and application rollback on isolated production-shaped environment.
stages.actual: No backup/restore or application rollback run was performed.

stages.expected: Measure performance and verify security controls, monitoring and alerts.
stages.actual: Only the existing grouping synthetic DB performance smoke passed; full load, security review and monitoring/alert delivery were not tested.

stages.expected: Validate CI and produce a reproducible release bundle tied to source and image digests.
stages.actual: Local build and tests passed; remote CI, signed/reproducible release artifacts and rollback package were not verified.

stages.expected: User accepts live portal behavior for an identified release candidate.
stages.actual: Not run. Depends on PROD-08–12 and an explicit user/operator live acceptance window.

stages.expected: Operator deploys and accepts the exact identified release on a named installation.
stages.actual: Not run. No target installation, release digests or operator acceptance record is available.
